mapper.sql: c.id, c.business_id, c.comment_type, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.is_stick, c.ip_source, c.create_time
mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE subtree AS ( SELECT c.id, c.business_id, c.comment_type, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.reply_user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.is_stick, c.ip_source, c.create_time FROM sys_comment c WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.parent_id IN #{item} UNION ALL SELECT c.id, c.business_id, c.comment_type, c.parent_id, c.user_id, c.reply_user_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.is_stick, c.ip_source, c.create_time FROM sys_comment c JOIN subtree s ON c.parent_id = s.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 ) SELECT t.id, t.business_id, t.comment_type, t.parent_id, t.user_id, t.content, t.like_count, t.is_stick, t.ip_source, t.create_time, u.nickname, u.avatar, ru.nickname as replyNickname, (SELECT COUNT(scl.id) > 0 FROM sys_comment_like scl WHERE scl.comment_id = t.id AND scl.user_id = #{userId,jdbcType=BIGINT}) AS is_like FROM subtree t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON t.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON t.reply_user_id = ru.id ORDER BY t.parent_id, t.create_time, t.id

SELECT c.id, c.business_id, c.comment_type, u.avatar, u.nickname, IF(ru.nickname is null,'无',ru.nickname) as replyNickname, c.content, c.parent_id, c.reply_user_id, c.is_stick, c.like_count, c.create_time, c.update_time, CASE c.comment_type WHEN 1 THEN p.product_name WHEN 2 THEN st.store_name WHEN 3 THEN b.brand_name WHEN 4 THEN pm.title END AS businessName FROM sys_comment c LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_user ru ON c.reply_user_id = ru.id LEFT JOIN shop_product p ON p.id = c.business_id AND c.comment_type = 1 LEFT JOIN shop_store st ON st.id = c.business_id AND c.comment_type = 2 LEFT JOIN shop_brand b ON b.id = c.business_id AND c.comment_type = 3 LEFT JOIN shop_plaza_message pm ON pm.id = c.business_id AND c.comment_type = 4
c.is_deleted = 0
and c.business_id = #{query.businessId}
and c.comment_type = #{query.commentType}
and u.nickname like concat('%', #{query.nickname}, '%')
and c.content like concat('%', #{query.content}, '%')
order by c.is_stick desc, c.create_time desc

SELECT c.id, c.business_id, c.comment_type, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM sys_comment c WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = #{userId} order by c.create_time desc

SELECT c.id, c.business_id, c.comment_type, c.parent_id, u.nickname as replyNickname, c.content, c.like_count, c.create_time, c.update_time FROM sys_comment c left join sys_user u on c.reply_user_id = u.id WHERE c.is_deleted = 0 AND c.user_id = #{userId} and c.reply_user_id is not null order by c.create_time desc
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_comment_like(comment_id, user_id, comment_type) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{userId}, #{commentType})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_comment_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(id) > 0 FROM sys_comment_like WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND comment_id = #{commentId}
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_comment SET like_count = GREATEST(IFNULL(like_count, 0) + #{delta}, 0) WHERE id = #{commentId} AND is_deleted = 0
